title: Lab - Manual scaling
description: Scale a Deployment by hand and observe.
scenario: Scale a Deployment by hand and observe. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 2 - Scale down
tasks.instructions: Scale it to 1 and note which Pods were removed.
tasks.solution:
kubectl scale deploy frontend --replicas=1
kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail

tasks.title: Task 3 - Edit
tasks.instructions: Set replicas back to 3 by editing the Deployment.
